description: Compare origin and destination risk for a logistics lane. Runs site-bound hazard/environmental profiles for both addresses and optionally adds FEMA disaster history for each area. Returns source coverage, point-in-time risk evidence, and an operational review checklist. This is informational public-record synthesis, not an insurance rating or route guarantee.

destination_area.description: Optional destination county/place for FEMA history.

destination_state.description: Optional destination 2-letter state, required with destination_area.

origin_area.description: Optional origin county/place for FEMA history.

origin_state.description: Optional origin 2-letter state, required with origin_area.

name: lane_location_risk_pack
